---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible failure in Capital Lab
labels: bug
---

Describe expected and observed behavior, the scenario, and reproduction steps.

Include the commit, Java version, PostgreSQL/Docker version, and failing test or request ID when
available. The dashboard returns an `X-Request-Id` header on every response and prints run
identifiers in the timeline; include those instead of a screenshot where possible.

Share synthetic evidence only; omit credentials and personal financial data.
